meta.name: Socios.com — UI Component Inventory
meta.description: Complete inventory of foundations, reusable components, variants, states, token dependencies, page-specific compositions, selectors and representative HTML extracted from the compiled Socios.com web app.
meta.colorScheme: light (default scheme); dark theme and 'socios' scheme documented as theming foundation

source.inspectedVia: local mirror served by server.mjs on :3210
source.stack: Next.js + React + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn-style primitives + Lucide icons

exclusions: Floating 'PRESENTER PREVIEW' aside (fixed, top-right, 290px) — prototype chrome, not product UI
Next.js error/404 documents (/equity, /equity/offering, /__not-found__) — no product content

conventions.noTestIds: The app ships no data-testid attributes; anchors use data-slot, role, aria-label, semantic tags and stable class names.
conventions.styleValues: Values are direct computed values or CSS custom properties. When a value varies by variant/size it is written as 'a | b' or 'a–b'.

scope.global: Present on every authenticated route through the app shell or shared primitives.
scope.repeated: Repeated component used in multiple sections/routes.
scope.page-specific: Composition specific to one route family.

foundations.name: Color system
foundations.description: Semantic CSS custom properties consumed through Tailwind v4 utilities. Light theme is the inspected default; a dark theme and two brand schemes (default, socios) exist behind data-theme/data-scheme. Brand violet is the only saturated action color; lime is reserved for price-up/success.

tokens.name: --bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Inset rows, chip backgrounds, active nav row, skeletons

tokens.name: --bg-brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected chips, bid panel, brand tint

tokens.name: --icon-brand
tokens.usage: Brand icons and active nav glyphs

notes: Text never uses pure black except --bg-inverse; primary text is #161226.
Price direction uses lime #c6ff00 for fills and #2f7d00 for text; losses use #e11d48.
Neutral palette values map to --color-neutral-* primitives; brand to --color-purple-20.

foundations.name: Typography
foundations.description: A single sans family (Inter) with a dense 10–96px scale and explicit line-height tokens. Headings use 700–900 weight; UI copy 400–600; numeric financial data uses tabular figures.

tokens.name: --font-mono
tokens.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

notes: Eyebrow pattern: 10–12px, uppercase, 700–800, letter-spacing 0.6px, color --text-subtle.
Financial values use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
No serif or decorative face is used anywhere in the product.

foundations.name: Spacing
foundations.description: 4px base grid exposed as named space tokens. Cards use 16/20px internal rhythm; page gutters are wider than component gaps.
notes: Page container padding: 24px 32px (desktop), reduced to ~16–20px on phones.
Widget cards: padding 20px, gap 16px.
Sidebar: padding 20px 12px; rows 2–4px apart.

foundations.name: Corner radius
foundations.description: Soft, highly rounded surfaces. Cards are 20px, nested surfaces 8–14px, actions are fully pill-shaped.

tokens.name: --radius-lg
tokens.usage: Widget cards, promo banners, dApp cards

tokens.name: --radius-xl
tokens.usage: Trade panel, large sheets, hero surfaces

notes: Nested media inside a 20px card uses 8–12px so the corners stay concentric.
Pills (buttons, chips, search) always use radius-full, never a fixed px value.

foundations.name: Borders and dividers
foundations.description: Hairline borders define structure instead of heavy shadows. Controls use a stronger outline than dividers; selected/brand states swap to solid brand.
notes: Dark artwork uses rgba(255,255,255,0.14–0.24) borders instead of the semantic tokens.
Divider borders are always top or bottom, never boxed around a card unless it is interactive.

foundations.name: Sizing and control heights
foundations.description: Dense desktop UI with 24–48px controls and 20–72px media. Touch targets expand on pointer:coarse via pseudo-elements.
notes: Buttons: xs 24, sm 28, default 32, lg 48.
Inputs: compact 32, standard 36–40, search pill 46.
Tap targets are at least 44px on coarse pointers even when visually 24–32px.

foundations.name: Elevation
foundations.description: Almost flat. Structure comes from surface color and 1px dividers; shadows are reserved for overlays, sticky chrome and hovered primary actions.
notes: Hero/artwork cards use gradients and photography, not elevation.
Do not stack shadows on dark surfaces; use a 1px white-alpha border instead.

foundations.name: Motion
foundations.description: Short, functional transitions. Color and transform only; all animation collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: fast
tokens.usage: Color, border, icon scale, nav hover

notes: Hover motion is wrapped in @media (hover:hover) so it does not stick on touch.
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) removes transforms and transition durations.

foundations.name: Layout and grid
foundations.description: Three-region app shell: fixed-height top bar, persistent 276px rail, and a padded main region. Content uses a 12-column widget grid and horizontal snap rails.
notes: Mobile: rail hidden below 1024px; destinations move to the bottom tab bar.
Widgets are absolutely positioned react-grid items inside .home-grid on dashboard routes.

foundations.name: Breakpoints
foundations.description: Tailwind default breakpoints plus an app-specific 1023px nav cutoff and a wide 1500px layout guard.

tokens.name: lg
tokens.usage: Desktop shell; sidebar appears / tab bar hides

tokens.name: nav cutoff
tokens.usage: Sidebar hidden, bottom tab bar active

notes: Cards also respond to @container widths, not just viewport breakpoints.
forced-colors:active is handled with explicit border fallbacks.

foundations.name: Iconography
foundations.description: Lucide line icons with 2px stroke, sized 10–30px. Club crests and token logos are raster/SVG images, never icon-font glyphs.

tokens.name: brand logos
tokens.value: image assets (crests, dApp logos, payment marks)

notes: Icons inherit currentColor; brand icons use --icon-brand.
Icon-only buttons always carry an aria-label and a 30–34px hit area.

foundations.name: Data visualization
foundations.description: Hand-rolled SVG charts (sparklines, area charts, donuts, gauges, probability bars) using the brand/lime/pink series. No charting library chrome.
notes: Charts use tabular numerals for axes and tooltips.
Area fills are 8–12% brand/lime tints, not solid blocks.

foundations.name: Theming
foundations.description: Token-driven light/dark themes and two schemes (default, socios). The design-system route exposes LIGHT/dark and SCHEME switches; the app defaults to light + default scheme.
notes: Components never hard-code light values; all surfaces read semantic tokens.
Artwork overlays keep white text and white-alpha borders regardless of theme.

components.name: Button

styles.border: outline: 1px solid var(--border-brand); others: 1px solid transparent

states.hover: primary: radial highlight at --spot-x/--spot-y + brand glow; secondary: bg-muted; ghost: bg-subtle; outline: bg-brand-subtle

components.description: Editorial feed row inside a bordered 'Today' section: source · time · interactions meta, two-line 18px headline, optional token delta chip, two-line summary and ghost like/comment/share actions.

states.hover: headline: color --text-brand; row: background color-mix(#000 2%, transparent)

components.name: Poll card

states.selected: aria-pressed="true" → background var(--bg-brand-subtle); border var(--border-brand); color var(--text-brand)

variants.name: result
variants.description: Label + percentage with a fill behind it.

components.description: Post-vote/closed result visualization: horizontal 8px track with brand fill, option label, percentage and a winner check. Often stacked under each option pill.

components.name: Transaction ceremony
components.description: Shared review → authorize (passkey) → settling → receipt flow used by trade, bid and stake actions. Composed of review rows, network-fee rows, a passkey step, a settling spinner and a receipt panel. Installed in the design system; not visible on static routes.

states.disabled: authorize CTA disabled until review acknowledged
states.focus: focus trapped per step; primary action focused
